name: Elgato Wave:3 - Premium USB Condenser Microphone for Streaming
short_description: USB condenser microphone with studio-quality 96kHz/24-bit audio. Proprietary condenser capsule with Clipguard anti-distortion technology. Digital mixing via Wave Link software. Ideal for streaming, podcasting, and YouTube.

name: SteelSeries QcK Heavy XXL - Extra-Large Gaming Mouse Pad
short_description: Extra-large cloth mouse pad measuring 900x400mm with 6mm thickness. QcK micro-woven surface for superior tracking accuracy with non-slip rubber base. Covers the entire desk for keyboard and mouse.

name: BenQ Zowie XL2546K - 240Hz Esports Gaming Monitor
short_description: Professional 24.5-inch gaming monitor with 240Hz refresh rate and 0.5ms response time. Exclusive DyAc+ technology for motion clarity with XL Setting to Share. The official monitor of global esports tournaments.

name: Corsair K70 RGB Pro - Legendary Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
short_description: Full-size mechanical keyboard with Cherry MX switches and per-key RGB lighting. Aluminum frame with magnetic wrist rest and 8000Hz polling rate. The gold standard in gaming keyboards.

name: Razer Basilisk V3 X HyperSpeed - Versatile Wireless Gaming Mouse
short_description: Wireless mouse with 18K DPI sensor and dual HyperSpeed 2.4GHz + Bluetooth connectivity. Ergonomic design with Tilt-Click scroll wheel. AA battery lasting up to 285 hours. A smart choice for work and gaming.

name: 8BitDo Arcade Stick - Authentic Arcade Experience at Home
short_description: Wireless arcade stick (Bluetooth + 2.4GHz + wired) compatible with PC, Switch, and Steam Deck. Genuine swappable Sanwa joystick and buttons. Perfect for fighting games and classic arcade titles.

name: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 - Multi-Platform Wireless Gaming Headset
short_description: Multi-platform wireless headset with simultaneous 2.4GHz and Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity. Nova Acoustic System drivers with Hi-Res audio. 38-hour battery with fast charging. Compatible with PC, PS5, Switch, and mobile.

name: Elgato HD60 X - External Capture Card for Streaming and Recording
short_description: External capture card recording at 4K30 or 1080p60 HDR10 with 4K60 HDR Passthrough. Compatible with PS5, Xbox, PC, and Switch via USB 3.0. The essential tool for content creators.

name: Razer BlackWidow V4 75% - Compact Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
short_description: 75% mechanical keyboard with Razer Orange Tactile switches. Per-key RGB lighting with magnetic wrist rest and rotary encoder knob. Compact layout without compromise.

name: HyperX Cloud III Wireless - Premium Wireless Gaming Headset
short_description: Wireless gaming headset with 2.4GHz connection and DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio. Angled 53mm drivers with memory foam cushions. Up to 120-hour battery life. Compatible with PC and PS5.

name: Razer DeathAdder V3 HyperSpeed - Ultra-Light Wireless Gaming Mouse
short_description: Professional wireless gaming mouse with Focus Pro 26K sensor and sub-1ms response time. Ultra-light 55g weight with up to 235-hour battery life. Iconic ergonomic design refined for esports.

name: 8BitDo Ultimate C Bluetooth Controller - Multi-Platform Gaming
short_description: Bluetooth wireless controller compatible with Nintendo Switch, Android, Steam, and PC. Ergonomic design with Hall Effect analog sticks. Excellent performance at a budget-friendly price.
